{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the 'status' column to confirm the values
print("Status values and counts:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check the 'channel' column to confirm the values
print("\nChannel values and counts:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check the 'converted' column to confirm the values
print("\nConverted values and counts:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check for any rows where 'revenue' is 0 but status is 'completed'
zero_revenue_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['revenue'] == 0) & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]
print("\nNumber of completed orders with revenue 0:")
print(len(zero_revenue_completed))

# Check if there are any internal test orders (likely indicated by 'converted' = 0 and revenue = 0)
test_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['revenue'] == 0) & (sales_df['converted'] == 0)]
print("\nNumber of test orders (revenue 0, converted 0):")
print(len(test_orders))"}
